about: docs/waffle.md. `valid`: a view that must check. `refusals`: a view (of component C, with `state n` and `state shown`) and the rule tag that refuses it. Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/waffle.rs.

valid.name: a waffle whose rest is known
valid.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 rest: "known" }

valid.name: a waffle whose rest is open
valid.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 rest: "open" }

valid.name: none counted, and all counted
valid.view: Waffle { label: "a" of: 4 counted: 0 columns: 2 } Waffle { label: "b" of: 4 counted: 4 columns: 2 }

valid.name: the most squares and the most columns
a chip of each tone
valid.view: Rich { Chip { tone: "good" "working" } Chip { tone: "warn" "alpha" } Chip { tone: "accent" "built" } Chip { tone: "quiet" "design" } }

valid.name: a chip in a heading and a link
valid.view: Heading { level: 2 "Stage " Chip { tone: "good" "ok" } } Rich { Link { to: "https://example.org/" "x " Chip { tone: "quiet" "y" } } }

valid.name: a waffle in a For and an If
valid.view: If { when: shown Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 } }

refusals.name: of true
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "a" of: true counted: 0 columns: 5 }

refusals.name: rest is another word
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 rest: "other" }

refusals.name: rest is a number
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 rest: 3 }

refusals.name: a waffle with text
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "a" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 Text { "x" } }

refusals.name: a gap on a Waffle
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 gap: 2 }

refusals.name: a tone on a Waffle
refusals.view: Waffle { label: "Tests" of: 10 counted: 7 columns: 5 tone: "ok" }
